title: Score a candidate graph
hook: Two stated cases: explore likelihood gain versus a parameter-count penalty.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How likelihood gain versus a parameter-count penalty affects the stated comparison
